subject.title: fix(discord): preserve content-type and skip optimization for animated/WebP images

question: Should the Discord fix be narrowed onto current main’s generic media-preservation policy, or should maintainers approve new public preserveWebp/preserveAvif SDK flags and their fail-closed cap behavior?
rationale: The MIME bug is real, but accepting new public SDK flags and changed over-cap delivery behavior is a product/API decision that should not be inferred from a stale bug-fix branch.

options.title: Narrow to current media policy
options.body: Keep the MIME-preserving Discord upload fix, remove the new public SDK flags, and rely on the existing generic preserve-under-cap/optimize fallback behavior.

options.title: Approve the new SDK flags
options.body: Treat preserveWebp and preserveAvif as an intentional plugin API expansion and add the docs, contract tests, and upgrade proof for the changed delivery behavior.

options.title: Replace this branch
options.body: Close or supersede this stale branch with a fresh current-main PR that preserves contributor credit and fixes only the Discord MIME path plus any still-missing animated media handling.

recommendation.title: Narrow to current media policy
recommendation.body: Keep the MIME-preserving Discord upload fix, remove the new public SDK flags, and rely on the existing generic preserve-under-cap/optimize fallback behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the broadest sampled ownership across the media policy, SDK seam, and Discord send paths affected by the product/API decision.
